newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco "regrets" U.S. congress vote on Jerusalem.
newsitem.headline: Morocco "regrets" U.S. congress vote on Jerusalem.

text.p: Morocco's foreign ministry on Friday criticised a resolution by the U.S. Congress stating that Jerusalem is the undivided capital of Israel, the official MAP news agency reported.
Quoting a foreign ministry statement, MAP said "the U.S Congress vote was regrettable and likely to fuel tensions at a time the (Middle East peace) process is deadlocked."
Last week, the U.S. House of Representatives approved by a large majority a non-binding resolution calling on President Clinton to reaffirm that Jerusalem must be Israel's undivided capital.
The U.S. administration believes the city's status is a sensitive issue still to be negotiated between Israel and the Palestinians. Israel captured Arab East Jerusalem in 1967.
